packageRules.description: Go dependencies are compiled into the shipped binary, so they should trigger a new patch release
The final stage is the image that gets published, so a base image update is a real release
The builder stage only compiles the binary and is discarded, so it should not trigger a release
Release tooling lives in package.json and is not part of the artifact, so it should not trigger a release
Workflow actions only affect CI and should not trigger a release
docker-compose.yml points at this project's own published image; updating it here would chase our own releases
